text: Looking after my niece (8) for the week while her parents are away and I just want a straight answer on whether I need to do anything tonight or if this can wait till morning. She's had chickenpox since yesterday, spots all over her tummy and back and some on her arms, and theyre really itchy, she keeps wanting to scratch them and I keep telling her not to. She's also got a runny nose, bit blocked at times, and shes been sneezing a fair bit, I think it's just a cold on top of everything but not sure. Temp was 37.6 last time I checked about half an hour ago. Apart from that she's honestly fine, eating, chatting, watching telly, being her usual cheeky self. I've put some cooling lotion on the spots. Mainly I want to know is there anything else I shoud be giving her for the itching or the temprature, and is it normal to have the cold symptoms as well or is that seperate. I'd rather not drag her out to a doctor at this hour if it's not needed, but tell me straight if it is.
